turns.user: I activated a 30-minute mobile ticket at 10:00 and transferred at 10:28.
turns.agent:
Under the 5 November 2026 snapshot, your transfer at 10:28 was within the 30-minute window that began at 10:00. If this was a transfer to your final ride, you may finish that ride even if it continues past 10:30; validate at the start of the new line as required. The 30-minute mobile ticket allows transfers on covered lines within its time window, and requires an internet-connected phone. BKK: 30-minute ticket

This is based on the dated snapshot, not a live check. Was 10:28 the start of your last ride, or will you transfer again?

turns.user: My last bus arrives at 10:48. Can I stay on that bus until the stop?
turns.agent:
Yes—if the 10:28 boarding was your final transfer. Under the 5 November 2026 snapshot, you can complete that last ride beyond the 30-minute window, so arriving at 10:48 is okay. The key is that the final transfer happened before 10:30; the 10:30 mark is not a deadline to get off the bus. BKK: 30-minute ticket

If you change to another line after 10:28, that would be another transfer, and the snapshot doesn’t support extending the ticket to start that later ride. This is dated guidance, not a live policy check.
